answer: I ran the Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit put H on q0, then a CNOT from q0 to q1, then measured both qubits. The job is 01a15f17-86cd-731d-8395-8db8bfbb535f and it completed. The counts are 00: 19, 01: 27, 10: 26, 11: 28. The bitstring keys are in IQM raw order, with the first qubit on the left. The counts are spread out across all four outcomes because the mock returns random results, as the docs say. A real QPU would give mostly 00 and 11. This mock job used no credits (estimated_credits 0.0). I submitted only this one job and made no real QPU runs.
